title: Demanding Requirements to Follow Jesus
description: On the way, Jesus meets three men who want to follow him. To the first one who promises to follow him everywhere, Jesus says that the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head. He calls the second himself, but the man wants first to bury his father; Jesus answers that the dead should bury their own dead and sends him out to proclaim the kingdom of God. The third wants first to say farewell to his family, but Jesus says that no one who looks back after putting a hand on the plow is fit for the kingdom of God.
